description: Continuous daily BigQuery telemetry lakehouse preserving multi-channel metrics (GSC, Clarity, Elementor audits, CPL) across client staging and production domains

schema.name: record_id
schema.description: Unique SHA-256 hash identifier for the daily telemetry audit run

schema.name: audit_date
schema.description: Calendar partition date for the cron execution

schema.name: timestamp
schema.description: Precise UTC timestamp of telemetry capture

schema.name: domain
schema.description: Apex production domain (e.g. burnetteconstructioninc.com)

schema.name: staging_subdomain
schema.description: Active staging subdomain (e.g. burnet.elkgroveseocompany.com)

schema.name: slack_channel_id
schema.description: Native Slack project communication channel ID

schema.name: notebook_id
schema.description: NotebookLM project ID maintaining entity ground truth

schema.name: gsc_total_impressions
schema.description: Total organic Google Search Console impressions over 30 days

schema.name: gsc_total_clicks
schema.description: Total organic Google Search Console clicks over 30 days

schema.name: gsc_avg_position
schema.description: Weighted average SERP position

schema.name: clarity_total_sessions
schema.description: Total verified human session recordings in Microsoft Clarity

schema.name: clarity_dead_clicks_pct
schema.description: Percentage of sessions containing dead clicks

schema.name: clarity_rage_clicks_pct
schema.description: Percentage of sessions containing rage clicks

schema.name: clarity_form_abandonment_pct
schema.description: Lead form start-to-dropoff friction percentage

schema.name: wcag_contrast_status
schema.description: WCAG 2.1 AA luminance-adaptive contrast audit status (PASS/FAIL)

schema.name: mobile_375px_overflow_status
schema.description: Mobile horizontal overflow audit status at 375px viewport (PASS/FAIL)

schema.name: elementor_native_widgets
schema.description: Count of compliant native Elementor widgets

schema.name: raw_html_injected_widgets
schema.description: Count of prohibited raw HTML code widgets (must strictly be 0)

schema.name: blended_cpl_usd
schema.description: Blended Cost-Per-Lead computed across paid channels

schema.name: estimated_lost_pipeline_value_usd
schema.description: Estimated commercial revenue lost due to UX friction and form leaks

schema.name: stage_7_status
schema.description: Stage 7 lifecycle status: PAUSED_STANDBY vs ACTIVE_RESUMED

schema.name: resumption_gate_state
schema.description: Resumption gate state: AWAITING_USER_PROMPT vs APPROVED_GREEN_SIGNAL
